描述_EN: the game uses a downloadable digital app as a crucial component of play; the app generates random elements that either help or hinder play. the board game is based on the reboot and was launched in 2015. the premise is that the players are leaders of the xcom organisation, fighting an alien invasion of earth. the original xcom was a computer game, first released in 1994 and rebooted in 2012.
描述_ZN: the game uses a downloadable digital app as a crucial component of play; the app generates random elements that either help or hinder play. 棋盘游戏是基于重启的游戏，于2015年推出。 前提是玩家是xcom组织的领导人，与入侵地球的外星人战斗。 最初的XCOM是一款电脑游戏，于1994年首次发布，并在2012年重新启动。
